tags.title: Alert
tags.summary: Persistent inline notice with semantic roles, optional actions and dismiss behavior.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Stable action value emitted in sf-alert-action.

attributes.name: action-text
attributes.description: Visible label of the primary optional action.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the alert looks: a filled surface, an outline, or flat.

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: Render an explicitly named close action.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Localized accessible name of the close action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close alert" in English).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Optional icon override. Use none to hide the semantic icon.

attributes.name: secondary-action
attributes.description: Stable secondary action value emitted in sf-alert-action.

attributes.name: secondary-action-text
attributes.description: Visible label of the secondary optional action.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the alert reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The words this component used before — clear and danger — are still accepted and mean neutral and error.

attributes.name: supporting-text
attributes.description: Supporting body text at the normal text size.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short message heading.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Avatar
tags.summary: Shows a person or organisation as a photo or initials, with an optional availability or verification mark. The default and label templates render a native button whose aria-label names its action; the card template is static and adds a title, description and meta line.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Avatar" in English).

attributes.name: badge-cap
attributes.description: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

attributes.name: badge-count
attributes.description: A count on the avatar (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the avatar's accessible name («Анна Белова, 3 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

attributes.name: badge-dot
attributes.description: A dot on the avatar, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

attributes.name: badge-label
attributes.description: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Takes the text line of this form size instead of a control height, for an avatar beside a label in a row or a table cell.

tags.title: Avatars
tags.summary: Ready combinations of avatars: a person with a source, a stacked group with a remainder, an avatar with two lines of label, and a profile avatar with a verified badge. Drawn from sf-avatar's parts; for a single avatar with a name or a card use sf-avatar.

tags.title: Badges
tags.summary: A short non-interactive label for a status, category, version or count beside an object, drawn in a size, appearance and colour role or status. It adds no keyboard or pointer behaviour.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the badge looks: the most visible fill, a calmer tonal one, or an outline.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Takes the text line of this form size, for a table cell or a row of fields, so the row keeps its control height.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Which semantic colour the badge takes. A status word given here still works and reaches the status axis.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the badge reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The word this component used before, danger, is still accepted and means error.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Breadcrumbs
tags.summary: Shows the current page's place in a hierarchy as a trail of native links built from items, the items attribute or sf-breadcrumbs-item children. A long trail collapses its middle into an ellipsis button (max-items, default 4) that expands in place.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Breadcrumb" in English).

attributes.name: expand-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show hidden breadcrumbs" in English).

tags.title: Buttons
tags.summary: A native button with Framework presentation: size, appearance, colour role or status, optional start and end icons, spacing and radius. loading sets aria-busy and disables it against repeated activation.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the button looks. Surface reads the neutral alpha ramp: a faint fill and a border. ghost is the link appearance under its old name (compat until 2026-12-01).

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible label for icon-only or custom buttons.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled state flag.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Single icon name shortcut.

attributes.name: icon-end
attributes.description: Logical end icon name.

attributes.name: icon-left
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for icon-start.

attributes.name: icon-position
attributes.description: Placement for the single icon shortcut.

attributes.name: icon-right
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for icon-end.

attributes.name: icon-start
attributes.description: Logical start icon name.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Loading state: the spinner at the icon's size in place of the start icon (else the end icon); without an icon it lies over the label, which keeps its place, so the width does not change. The spinner takes the page's look (data-sf-spinner). Sets aria-busy and disables the native button.

attributes.name: native-type
attributes.description: Native button type attribute.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Border radius modifier.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Extra classes applied to the inner button element.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Which colour family the control takes. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Button size token.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Semantic internal spacing profile.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the control is about, in the shared status vocabulary. The only one a control paints today is `error`, the destructive one: a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Visible button text when no text slot is provided.

attributes.name: tightness
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for spacing.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Button group
tags.summary: A controlled single-selection group built from SF5 buttons.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the group looks. default joins outlined buttons into one perimeter; segmented draws a sunken track with borderless segments and a plate under the selected one. The selection model, keyboard and events are the same.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the group.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the whole group.

attributes.name: full-width
attributes.description: In the segmented appearance, the track fills its container and the segments share the width equally.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Selectable items with stable value, label, icon, count, icon-only, disabled and loading fields.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Native form field name: the group submits its value with its form, a form reset restores the initial value, and a disabled group is left out.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and keyboard navigation orientation.

attributes.name: plate
attributes.description: The selected segment's plate in the segmented appearance: the scheme's fill, or a raised neutral surface with its shadow.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Corner radius, as on sf-button: empty is the UI radius. In the segmented appearance the plate, a button-sized segment, takes the radius a button of that value has, and the track is it plus the padding (rounded: both pills).

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Extra classes applied to the group root.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Color scheme for the selected button, and for the selected plate in the segmented appearance.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Shared button size token.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Shared semantic internal spacing profile.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template variant name.

attributes.name: theme-switch
attributes.description: A ready theme switch: the group draws its own three icon-only items (system, light, dark) named in the page language, selects SF.Loader's theme preference and follows sf-theme-change, and a choice calls SF.Loader.setTheme. items is ignored.

attributes.name: tightness
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for spacing.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Currently selected item value.

tags.title: Checkbox
tags.summary: A native checkbox with a label, Framework presentation and checked, indeterminate and disabled states kept in step between the host attributes and the inner input.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a checkbox rendered without a visible label.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Invalid state; the native input publishes aria-invalid.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Mixed visual state for a checkbox that summarizes related options.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Logical placement of the indicator relative to its text.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Checkbox size token.

tags.title: Close
tags.summary: The decorative cross glyph of a close action, sized on the control ladder. It is aria-hidden and never focusable; the containing native button owns the action and its name.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Decorative close-glyph size token.

tags.title: Color
tags.summary: A colour control: a swatch that opens the platform picker, the colours a product already has as presets, and a way back to an inherited colour. Built as a general part because a colour is set in a theme, in a site look, on a label and on a chart series, not only on a record.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the swatch is bounded.

attributes.name: choose-label
attributes.description: The words on the swatch. Unset, the component answers in the page's language ("Choose a colour" in English).

attributes.name: clear-label
attributes.description: The words on the control that returns to the inherited colour. Unset, it follows the page's language.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Whether a chosen colour can be returned to the inherited one.

attributes.name: inherited-text
attributes.description: What is read in place of a value while nothing is chosen. Unset, it follows the page's language.

attributes.name: inherited-value
attributes.description: The colour that applies while nothing is chosen. Shown as inherited rather than drawn as the value: a control that drew it as the value would make «not set» and «set to the same colour» look identical, and only one of them follows the theme when the theme changes.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the control.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form name. A hidden input carries the value under it, empty while the inherited colour applies.

attributes.name: reset-label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the button that returns to the inherited colour; `clear-label` still names it. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size ladder step, so a colour beside a text field lines up with it.

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: The colours a product already has, comma separated, each #hex or #hex|Name; a name may hold spaces. A piece without a name may list several colours by spaces. A person picks the brand colour rather than matching a hex by eye.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Which template draws it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The colour, as #rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa. Empty means nothing is chosen and the inherited colour applies.

tags.title: Composition overlay
tags.summary: Editor chrome over a rendered Composition Document: frames, labels, badges, action toolbar, insertion places, drag and keyboard moves and a keyboard tree, without changing the canvas HTML. A framed mode draws the same chrome over a same-origin iframe fed a flat node list, with plain-string inline editing.

attributes.name: accepts
attributes.description: sf-sortable groups whose items may be dropped on insertion places

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: id of the canvas element that holds SF.Composition.render output

attributes.name: frame
attributes.description: id of a same-origin iframe canvas (framed mode, fed by setNodes); used instead of for

tags.title: Context Menu
tags.summary: The Framework's action menu: data entries with icon, caption, value, shortcut, check, submenu, separator and heading, opened by openFor() into the top layer, anchored, with keyboard, typeahead and focus return. A host may still render its own items and own the lifecycle.

attributes.name: active-tab
attributes.description: The chosen tab's id or index; the host renders that tab's rows into the content slot.

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: A close button at the end of the panel's head.

attributes.name: entries
attributes.description: The menu as data (set as a property, or JSON in the attribute). See item_contract. When present, it replaces items and the content slot.

attributes.name: popup
attributes.description: Not drawn until opened through openFor(). A menu without it is drawn in place, as before.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Deprecated: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0 (owner, 2026-10-12); the value is kept for its class and draws nothing.

deprecated.replacement: openFor(anchor, {side, align}) places the menu; no tail is drawn

attributes.name: search
attributes.description: {placeholder, empty, remote}: a search field above the rows (set as a property). Local by default; with remote: true the menu raises sf-context-menu-search {query} and shows the entries the host sets. A submenu entry passes it with `search`.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The menu's size: rows as tall as a field of that size (32px at 1/2, 40px at 1), its text, insets, search and footer. A submenu takes its parent's size.

attributes.name: tabs
attributes.description: A panel with tabs: labels separated by |, or [{id, label}] as a property. The head (tabs and the close button) and the footer never scroll, the body does, and the panel keeps a fixed width (a ladder step, or width) whatever a tab holds.

attributes.name: tooltip
attributes.description: Deprecated: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0 (owner, 2026-10-12); the value is kept for its class and draws nothing.

deprecated.replacement: none: a menu has no tail

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: How wide openFor() opens the menu: content (its longest line, between --sf-context-menu--min-inline-size and --sf-context-menu--max-inline-size), trigger (exactly the control that opened it; a long line ends in an ellipsis) or a CSS length. openFor(anchor, {width}) overrides it.

tags.title: Copy button
tags.summary: Copies a value or a target's text, confirms with a check and a polite announcement, and selects the text for Ctrl+C when the browser refuses the clipboard.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds the result stays.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: The resting glyph: link, key, ...

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name, saying what is copied («Скопировать команду»); «Копировать» / Copy by default.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: #id of an input (its value) or an element (its text; a numbered code block without its numbers). value and target together are an error.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: A visible label; empty draws an icon-only button.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The text to copy.

tags.title: Country Code
tags.summary: A telephone field with a country picker: a button opens a searchable listbox of countries, and the chosen country sets the dial code, flag and, optionally, the input mask of the native tel input.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a telephone field rendered without a visible label.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: Optional id of the native owning form when the field is outside it.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Language of the country names and the field's own words: ru or en. When not set it follows the page: Russian on a Russian page, English otherwise.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Native input name used by FormData and form submission.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Native required phone input; the country prefix alone does not satisfy the requirement.

tags.title: Datepicker
tags.summary: Accessible date and date-range picker with popup and inline presentation, calendar navigation and host-owned values.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a date field rendered without a visible label.

attributes.name: close-on-select
attributes.description: Close the panel once a date (or a range end) is chosen.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: Which grid the panel opens on: days (empty), month or year.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: The ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd) chosen; value is read only when date is absent, so date="" is a cleared value.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable the field and the panel.

attributes.name: end-value
attributes.description: Range only: the ISO end date.

attributes.name: error-message
attributes.description: The message under an invalid field; ignored while the field is valid.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How the date is shown in the field and read when typed, e.g. DD.MM.YYYY: the whole text one date, a four-digit year from 1000 to 9999. The value stays ISO.

attributes.name: icon-start
attributes.description: The icon at the start of the field; the canonical name for left-icon.

attributes.name: input
attributes.description: Draw the text field; without it only the panel is drawn.

attributes.name: input-name
attributes.description: The form field name of the value; wins over name.

attributes.name: input-root-class
attributes.description: Classes added to the field's root.

attributes.name: input-size
attributes.description: Legacy name for size, still honoured; size wins when both are set. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: input-type
attributes.description: The field's appearance (bordered by default), as on sf-inputs.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Draw the field invalid: the error border and aria-invalid on the native input. Removing it restores the valid field.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The field's visible label.

attributes.name: left-icon
attributes.description: Legacy name for icon-start, still honoured; icon-start wins when both are set.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: The language of month and day names; defaults to the page language.

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: Mask what can be typed in the field to the format.

attributes.name: mask-lazy
attributes.description: Show the mask's placeholder characters only as they are typed.

attributes.name: mask-options
attributes.description: Further mask options as JSON, passed to the field's mask.

attributes.name: mask-pattern
attributes.description: Input mask; when not set it is derived from format, so the default format DD.MM.YYYY gives 00.00.0000.

attributes.name: mask-placeholder-char
attributes.description: The character that stands for a position not yet typed.

attributes.name: max-date
attributes.description: The latest ISO date that can be chosen; later days are disabled.

attributes.name: min-date
attributes.description: The earliest ISO date that can be chosen; earlier days are disabled.

attributes.name: month
attributes.description: The month shown when the panel opens, 0-11; defaults to the chosen date's month, else the current one.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name of the value. input-name is the same and wins when both are set.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the panel is open.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: The field's placeholder text.

attributes.name: portal
attributes.description: Draw the panel at the end of the document so no clipping ancestor cuts it.

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description: The chosen quick range's id. Set by a host it wins over start-value and end-value, and a relative one is resolved against today in the person's time zone when drawn; nothing is emitted for it.

attributes.name: presets
attributes.description: Range only: quick ranges beside the grid. Built-in ids, comma separated (today, yesterday, last-7-days, last-30-days, this-week, this-month, last-month), or as a property [{id, label, relative} | {id, label, range: [from, to]}]. Clamped to min-date and max-date; a range with nothing left is disabled.

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Pick a start and an end instead of one date.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Keeps the field read-only: the date is chosen on the grid only. A single date can be typed by default; a range is always chosen on the grid.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Mark the field required in its form.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Classes added to the component's root.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Form size of the field.

attributes.name: start-value
attributes.description: Range only: the ISO start date.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Which template draws it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd). As a property, [start, end] for a range. The attribute is the initial value: once the date is cleared it stays empty.

attributes.name: week-start
attributes.description: The first day of the week, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday (1 Monday). Without the attribute it follows the page's language (ru: Monday, en-US: Sunday, ar-EG: Saturday).

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The year shown when the panel opens; defaults to the chosen date's year, else the current one.

tags.title: Download File
tags.summary: Native file download or application-owned file preparation action.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Render a disabled button with no live destination.

attributes.name: download
attributes.description: Apply native download semantics to an anchor destination.

attributes.name: file-name
attributes.description: Visible filename and default native download name.

attributes.name: file-size
attributes.description: Known human-readable size. Pass it when available to avoid discovery.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Real resource destination; renders a native anchor when enabled.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Decorative icon name.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Existing compact-to-prominent component size scale.

tags.title: Drawer
tags.summary: Workspace side panel that keeps the page usable: docked column or modeless panel. Modal side panels belong to sf-modal; the modal Drawer mode is deprecated.

attributes.name: block-start
attributes.description: Where this panel starts from the top (an app bar's height); the --sf-drawer-block-start variable sets it for every panel.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close drawer" in English).

attributes.name: controlled
attributes.description: An outside switch (an element naming the drawer in aria-controls) opens and closes the panel: no close button while that switch is on screen.

attributes.name: dock-breakpoint
attributes.description: From what width of the dock host (or the window, without a host) a docked drawer is a column of the page; narrower, it floats over the page. A length in rem, em or px. Empty: the --sf-drawer-dock-breakpoint variable where the drawer stands, else 48rem.

attributes.name: gutter
attributes.description: The inline gutter the head and the body share, as a length (for example var(--sf-space-3)), so the title and the content start on one axis. Empty: the drawer's own, space-1. A theme may set --sf-drawer-gutter instead.

attributes.name: panel-style
attributes.description: Declarations set on the panel itself, for the custom properties it reads -- its background, radius, shadow. A consumer painting its content a different colour than the panel leaves the head and the gutters in the other one.

attributes.name: snap
attributes.description: A bottom sheet's resting height: its content's, half the room under the app bar, or all of it.

attributes.name: stack-offset
attributes.description: How much of each drawer below shows past the one above it at the same edge, as a length (for example var(--sf-space-4)). A drawer stands depth × offset in from its edge, where depth counts the open, undocked drawers below it at that edge. Empty: drawers lie flush.

tags.title: Dropdown
tags.summary: Accessible single or multiple selection control with searchable options and optional portal projection.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the dropdown looks: a filled field or an outlined one.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: How many options a row holds in the grid layout. Ignored in a list.

attributes.name: inherited-text
attributes.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

attributes.name: inherited-value
attributes.description: The option value (values joined by commas when several may be chosen) the field falls back to while nothing is chosen. Its options' labels are shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as a choice: the form value stays empty. Once something is chosen, a reset button returns it here. Select mode; a tag-mode field does not draw it.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: How the options are laid out. A list is one option a row; a grid puts several in a row, which is the only way a hundred glyphs can be looked at -- a column of them is a column nobody scrolls to the end of. In a grid an option shows its picture and keeps its text as the name a search reads and a pointer sees.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allow several values while preserving their serialized selection order. Tag mode is multiple by default.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Native form field name for the selected machine value.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Options given as data instead of as sf-list-item children: [{text, value, type?, size?, icon?, selected?, disabled?, colorClass?, avatarImageUrl?, avatarTitle?, ariaLabel?, group?}]. A string or a number is taken as both the label and the value. A parent that renders this dropdown from a template passes its options this way, because capturing child elements means removing them, and the parent can then no longer put a changed list back. Options carrying the same `group`, one after another, are drawn under one heading, so a long list says where each stretch of it comes from instead of repeating that in every row.

attributes.name: portal
attributes.description: Anchor the popup with the shared Framework positioning (SF.Position): native top layer, flip, shift and viewport-limited height. On by default; portal="false" keeps the in-flow list.

attributes.name: reset-label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

attributes.name: search-placeholder
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Search" in English).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected machine value, or a comma-separated list of values for multiple selection.

tags.title: Empty state
tags.summary: What a list, a panel or a page says when it has nothing to show: no data, nothing found, no access or an error, with an icon, a real heading, a sentence and actions.

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: The title's outline level; its look follows the size.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: The reason, which picks the default icon, title and text, and for error a «Повторить» action.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: inline: one line for a list inside a menu, a dropdown or a search -- a small icon, the words and at most one link action, no heading.

attributes.name: live
attributes.description: auto: nothing-found and error are a polite status, the others say nothing; alert: an error the person caused; off: the host announces it.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: 1/3 is always the inline form; 1/2 inside a table or panel, 2 for a whole page: the icon, title role, text and gaps follow.

tags.title: File Preview
tags.summary: Accessible Smart projection of the ordinary File Preview row.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("File" in English).

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Only the leading visual, as tall as a list row's line: the image, or the file's extension in a tile. For a file in a table cell.

attributes.name: download-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Download file" in English).

attributes.name: file-size
attributes.description: The file's size as text, for example 12 KB.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the preview shows: an icon, the image itself, or whichever suits the file.

attributes.name: remove-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Remove file" in English).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Legacy name for file-size: the file's own size as text ("12 KB"), not the size ladder. Still honoured; pass file-size.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: File Upload
tags.summary: A drop area that opens the platform file dialog or takes dropped files, filtered by accept, and lists each file with its upload progress, an error with a retry, and removal. The host uploads; the component shows the state the host sets.

attributes.name: formats
attributes.description: Formats line shown under the action. When not set it is derived from accept, and is empty when neither is given: the component names no formats it cannot know.

attributes.name: link-text
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Click to upload" in English).

attributes.name: supporting-text
attributes.description: Supporting line; falls back to formats.

tags.title: Gallery
tags.summary: An ordered media collection shown in an inline Slider, with an optional Modal lightbox holding a second Slider. The gallery owns the one-based current slide and keeps both views on it.

tags.title: Help mark
tags.summary: A «?» beside a label that opens a short explanation on a press -- a toggletip -- announced politely, closed by Escape, a second press or a click outside.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The button's accessible name; «Подробнее» / More information by default, best naming the subject («Подробнее: код решения»).

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: The explanation; slot `content` takes links or lists instead.

tags.title: Icons
tags.summary: Semantic Material Symbol wrapper with exact Loader tracking, accessible decorative or informative modes and token-owned geometry.

attributes.name: badge-cap
attributes.description: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

attributes.name: badge-count
attributes.description: A count on the icon (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the icon's accessible name («Почта, 3 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

attributes.name: badge-dot
attributes.description: A dot on the icon, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

attributes.name: badge-label
attributes.description: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

tags.title: Icon Buttons
tags.summary: Native icon-only action with token geometry, accessible naming and shared loading semantics.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the icon button looks. Surface and ghost read the neutral alpha ramp: surface keeps a faint fill and a border, ghost keeps nothing until it is hovered or focused.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible label.

attributes.name: badge-cap
attributes.description: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

attributes.name: badge-count
attributes.description: A count on the icon button (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the icon button's accessible name («Уведомления, 5 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

attributes.name: badge-dot
attributes.description: A dot on the icon button, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

attributes.name: badge-label
attributes.description: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled state flag.

attributes.name: filled
attributes.description: Use the filled glyph axis for the standard icon variant.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Material icon name.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the icon button is: an ordinary icon action or a close control.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Loading state: the spinner in place of the icon, at the icon's size, in the page's look (data-sf-spinner). Sets aria-busy and disables the native button.

attributes.name: native-type
attributes.description: Native button type attribute.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Border radius modifier.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Extra classes applied to the inner icon button element.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Which colour family the control takes. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Joined-control position owned by Button Group composition.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Icon button size token.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Semantic internal spacing profile.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the control is about, in the shared status vocabulary. The only one a control paints today is `error`, the destructive one: a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

attributes.name: tightness
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for spacing.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Inputs
tags.summary: A native single-line form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and optional mask integration.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the field looks: a bordered box, a filled one, or hidden.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a field rendered without a visible label; it lands on the native input.

attributes.name: inherited-text
attributes.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

attributes.name: inherited-value
attributes.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no value of its own -- a default from a parent setting, a brand, a theme. Shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a value of its own, a reset button returns it here. A number field is sf-input with inputmode numeric or decimal and takes it the same way.

attributes.name: reset-label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: List Item
tags.summary: Declarative option descriptor owned by Dropdown, and a general list row: supporting line, interactive rows with roving focus, sf-sortable items and pinned rows.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: A row a person acts on: hover, focus and selection states, one Tab stop per list with arrow keys, Home and End, and sf-list-item-activate on click or Enter.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the list item carries: plain text, an icon, a checkbox, an avatar or a colour.

attributes.name: pinned
attributes.description: A row of an sf-sortable list that does not move: no handle, not an item of the list, its handle slot kept empty so the text columns line up.

attributes.name: sortable-item
attributes.description: The row's item id in the surrounding sf-sortable list. The row carries data-sf-sortable-item and a drag handle; the list's keyboard reordering applies.

attributes.name: supporting
attributes.description: A second line under the title, one step of the size ladder smaller. Not used by a Dropdown option.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Modal
tags.summary: A dialog window over the page in the shared modal stack: centered or at a side, top or bottom edge, with header, content and footer slots, focus trap, scroll lock and focus return. It can also be minimized, load its content by Ajax or into an iframe, or render inline in the page flow.

attributes.name: footer-class
attributes.description: Classes on the footer. Its actions stand at the end with --sf-modal-footer-gap (space-1/2) between them; those defaults sit under the utilities, so a utility here still wins.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Dialog" in English).

tags.title: Page header
tags.summary: The head of an admin page: path, heading, count, favourite star, install mark and main action. Replaces the admin top bar together with sf-admin-menu.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: How many records the page holds; empty draws no count. The admin menu carries no totals, so this is where they are.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The page heading.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: install marks a page shared by every site.

attributes.name: star
attributes.description: Empty draws no star; off and on draw it in that state.

tags.title: Pagination
tags.summary: Source-driven navigation for a collection split into numbered pages.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Selected batch-action value.

attributes.name: action-apply-text
attributes.description: Label of the batch-action apply button. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Apply" in English).

attributes.name: action-choose-label
attributes.description: Placeholder of the batch-action selector, shown until an action is chosen. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Choose an action" in English).

attributes.name: action-for-all
attributes.description: Current all-items toggle value.

attributes.name: action-for-all-label
attributes.description: Label of the all-items toggle. Empty: the text of the page's language ("For all" in English).

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: Pipe-separated compatible batch-action definitions.

attributes.name: actions-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the batch-action selector. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Action for the selected records" in English).

attributes.name: actions-region-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the panel that appears while rows are marked. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Actions for the selected" in English).

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Result pages" in English).

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.description: Allow the compatible batch-action section.

attributes.name: bottom-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the batch-action section.

attributes.name: can-count
attributes.description: Whether the host can count on request. Without it the view offers nothing and asks for nothing.

attributes.name: clear-selection-label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that drops the selection. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Clear the selection" in English).

attributes.name: count-known
attributes.description: Whether the number of records is known. A host that does not count every answer sets it false, and the view offers the number instead of showing it.

attributes.name: counting
attributes.description: A count is on its way; the view shows a short wait in place of the number.

attributes.name: counting-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the short wait shown while the count is on its way. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Counting" in English).

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Current one-based page number.

attributes.name: first-label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that goes to the first page. Empty: the text of the page's language ("First" in English).

attributes.name: has-next
attributes.description: Whether a further page exists. It is what moves forward and Show more when no total was sent.

attributes.name: last-label
attributes.description: Visible label of the compatible last-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Last" in English).

attributes.name: main-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the navigation section.

attributes.name: middle
attributes.description: Show page navigation and collection summary.

attributes.name: next-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the next-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Next page" in English).

attributes.name: page-field-label
attributes.description: Label of the field that takes a page number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page:" in English).

attributes.name: page-label
attributes.description: Accessible prefix for a numbered page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page" in English).

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Positive number of items per page.

attributes.name: page-size-label
attributes.description: Visible and accessible label of the page-size selector. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Per page:" in English).

attributes.name: page-sizes
attributes.description: Comma-separated positive page-size choices.

attributes.name: pages-label
attributes.description: Visible label before page controls. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Pages:" in English).

attributes.name: previous-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the previous-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Previous page" in English).

attributes.name: selected-count
attributes.description: Selected item count, clamped between zero and total.

attributes.name: selected-label
attributes.description: Visible label for the selected item count. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Selected:" in English).

attributes.name: show-action-for-all
attributes.description: Show the compatible all-items toggle.

attributes.name: show-actions
attributes.description: Show batch actions when actions are supplied.

attributes.name: show-count-label
attributes.description: Text of the control that asks the host for the number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show the number" in English).

attributes.name: show-more-busy
attributes.description: Mark the Show more control as working while the host fetches the next portion; it is disabled and shows a loader.

attributes.name: show-more-text
attributes.description: Label of the compatible show-more action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show more" in English).

attributes.name: show-page-size
attributes.description: Show the page-size selector for a non-empty collection.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The step of the size ladder its fields, buttons, labels and page numbers take: 1, or the dense 1/2 of an admin.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template name.

attributes.name: top
attributes.description: Show the compatible show-more section.

attributes.name: top-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the show-more section.

attributes.name: total
attributes.description: Non-negative total item count.

attributes.name: total-label
attributes.description: Visible label for the total item count. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Total:" in English).

tags.title: Popover
tags.summary: A surface anchored to a control the consumer supplies, with its own open state, dismissal and returned focus. Built as a general part because the Framework had the surface and not the behaviour: two composites wrote it by hand within a week, the second copying the first.

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: Esc and a press outside close it. A consumer that owns those keys turns this off and calls close() when it decides.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the surface. A surface with a role and no name is announced as an unnamed one.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the surface is shown. Reflected, so a consumer can read it and set it.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Which corner of the trigger the surface hangs from.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Legacy name for surface-role. Read once and removed from the host, which is not itself a menu or dialog.

attributes.name: surface-role
attributes.description: What the surface is to a reader: dialog, menu, listbox or group. Written on sf-popover; the surface gets the role and the trigger aria-haspopup.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template variant name.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: A width of its own. Left to its content a surface takes the width of its longest line, which a list of names makes wide and ragged.

tags.title: Profile picker
tags.summary: One way to choose, make, rename, remove and reset a profile: a field-like button naming the profile in use, and a panel where every act happens inline. The profiles and the rights are the host's; the component says what was asked.

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: The id of the profile in use.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What a profile is called here («Профиль», «Вид»); the page language's «Profile» when empty.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Why the host refused the last act, shown in the panel.

attributes.name: resettable
attributes.description: Offers «Сбросить к стандартному» at the foot.

tags.title: Progress Bar
tags.summary: Continuous determinate progress with normalized value, accessible range semantics and explicit semantic tone.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the progress reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The word this component used before, primary, is still accepted and means neutral.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Progress Scale
tags.summary: Segmented determinate progress with exact accessible value, explicit semantic tone and ten visual steps.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Takes the text line of this form size, for a table cell or a row of fields, so the row keeps its control height.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the progress reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The word this component used before, primary, is still accepted and means neutral.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Radio
tags.summary: One radio option: a native radio input with a label, description and help text. Radios with the same name form a group in which checking one unchecks the others.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Radio size token.

tags.title: Range Slider
tags.summary: A slider for one number or a range of two on a track: drag, click or keys move a handle by step, the fill shows the chosen part, and the value can be shown as text or a tooltip on each handle.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: How each handle shows its value: not at all, as text beside it, or as a tooltip.

tags.title: Reference Link
tags.summary: Navigation surface that pairs a real destination with a compact reference.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: card is the reference as its own box: frame, fill and padding. plain is the link alone, taking the width of its text, for a reference inside something that is already a box -- a record’s field, a table cell -- where a second frame reads as a control the value is not.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Render an unavailable, non-focusable reference without navigation.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Real navigation destination. Required for an enabled reference.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Decorative icon name. An absent attribute is the arrow; an empty one draws no icon, for a reference that stands beside its own label.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Destination-oriented visible link label.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Takes the text line of this form size as a link without the card, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Form size: the reference becomes a control of that size, for a row of fields or a table cell. Empty keeps the card spacing.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Native browsing-context target. Disclose new-context navigation in the name.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Compact route, source or reference shown beside the label.

tags.title: Resizer
tags.summary: A handle on a panel's edge that changes the panel's width by a drag, the keyboard or a double click back to the default, within limits; optionally remembered in the browser.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name; defaults to the page language's «Resize».

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: The widest width, a CSS length.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: The narrowest width, a CSS length (tokens and percentages of the panel's parent too).

attributes.name: property
attributes.description: A CSS custom property the width is written to on the target; empty writes inline-size.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Pixels an arrow key moves; Shift moves four steps.

attributes.name: storage-key
attributes.description: Remembers the width in this browser as the view preference sf-resizer/<key> (SF.Preferences); a double click forgets it.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: A selector of the closest ancestor that is the panel; empty is the parent.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A width in pixels the host keeps (a person's settings); it wins over the browser's memory.

tags.title: Skeleton
tags.summary: Decorative loading placeholder that reserves source-backed content geometry with semantic tokens and reduced-motion support.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What shape the placeholder takes: a line of text, a circle, a square or a rounded block.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: type="icon" marks a placeholder that stands in for an icon; it combines with any kind. Not a legacy name for kind (see contracts/public-api-axes.json), so it has no removal date.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Slider
tags.summary: A row of slides moved by arrows, dots, swipe or keys, built on the shared Swiper adapter; with linked thumbnails a second slider picks the slide.

tags.title: Sortable
tags.summary: Drag-and-drop list primitive for reordering, moving between lists and copying from a library by mouse, pen, touch and keyboard, with an optional insertion point that opens a searchable inserter; reports intent only.

attributes.name: inserter-items
attributes.description: Opt-in insertion point. JSON array (or the inserterItems property) of [{value, label, icon?, caption?, keywords?, disabled?}], with {type: "heading", label} and {type: "separator"} to group them. When it holds at least one item, a "+" on the gap between items (and before the first, after the last) opens a searchable inserter of these kinds; empty or absent, the list draws and does nothing more than before.

attributes.name: preview
attributes.description: How a pointer drag shows where the item lands: silhouette lifts the item out of the list and opens an outline of its size at the place it would take, the list making room; line draws a thin line there and leaves the list as it is. Keyboard moves and external targets always use the line; a list that wraps into a grid opens the outline as one of its cells, in reading order.

tags.title: Spinner
tags.summary: Indeterminate waiting indicator in one of four looks on the size ladder (arc, breathing, comet, dots), following the page's data-sf-spinner, with optional polite status announcement and Framework-owned motion.

attributes.name: dot-radius
attributes.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-20, read until 2026-12-01 (journal attribute-spinner-pixel-geometry): the size ladder decides the spinner's geometry; write size.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-20, read until 2026-12-01 (journal attribute-spinner-pixel-geometry): the size ladder decides the spinner's geometry; write size.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: The spinner's look: arc, breathing (the arc grows and shrinks as it turns), comet (an arc with a fading tail) or dots. Empty: the page's look, data-sf-spinner on the nearest ancestor (html, body or a block), else arc.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Loading…" in English).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size ladder: at each step the spinner is the icon of an sf-button of the same size (diameter and stroke), so it can stand in for that icon.

attributes.name: stroke-width
attributes.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-20, read until 2026-12-01 (journal attribute-spinner-pixel-geometry): the size ladder decides the spinner's geometry; write size.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Deprecated since 2026-10-20, read until 2026-12-01 (journal attribute-spinner-pixel-geometry): the size ladder decides the spinner's geometry; write size.

tags.title: Steps
tags.summary: A row of labelled step buttons, separated by an icon, for a multi-step process: marks the current, completed and error steps and moves to an enabled step when it is pressed.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Steps" in English).

attributes.name: completed-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Completed" in English).

attributes.name: error-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Error" in English).

tags.title: Switch
tags.summary: An on/off control for a setting that applies at once: a native checkbox with role="switch", a track and a moving thumb, with a label, description and help text.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a switch rendered without a visible label, as in a record panel that draws the label itself.

attributes.name: inherited-text
attributes.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

attributes.name: inherited-value
attributes.description: Whether the switch is on while it holds no value of its own: true/on or false/off. The knob stands where it says, quieter, with an «inherited» marker, and the checkbox submits nothing. With it set, «off» chosen by a person is kept as checked="false" -- a value of its own -- and no `checked` at all means the inherited state; a reset button returns there.

attributes.name: reset-label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Switch size token.

tags.title: Tabs
tags.summary: A tab list that shows one local panel at a time, with text or icon tabs given as attributes, slots or data, roving keyboard focus and linked tab panels.

attributes.name: configurable
attributes.description: A gear at the end of the tabs («Настроить вкладки») opens the standard menu with the tabs as a sortable list, a visibility checkbox per tab (pinned tabs fixed) and «Сбросить» in its footer. The choice is the host's: sf-tabs-settings-change {order, hidden}, sf-tabs-settings-reset, setSettings({order, hidden}).

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: An item (set with setItems) may carry key (a stable id for the settings; the index otherwise), icon, count (a small counter after the label), href (the tab is a link: activating it goes to the address; aria-current=page on the active one) and pinned (never hidden, fixed in the settings).

attributes.name: overflow
attributes.description: What the tabs do when they do not fit: scroll (the row scrolls), wrap (rows wrap), or more (the tabs that do not fit go into a trailing «Ещё (n)» menu; the active one always stays).

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Built-in button appearance: default, outline or link. Historical name retained; this is not a semantic color selector. Custom templates may interpret it separately.

tags.title: Tags
tags.summary: Compact static, selectable and removable labels with one explicit interaction owner.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Selected state of a checkbox tag.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Visual appearance, read from the neutral alpha ramp and separate from type: surface keeps a faint fill and a boundary, ghost keeps nothing until it is hovered. Only the neutral types take it, because a status tag carries its meaning in its colour.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Optional accessible name override for a selectable tag.

attributes.name: avatar-image-url
attributes.description: Avatar image URL; the visible text remains the accessible label.

attributes.name: avatar-status
attributes.description: Reserved avatar status value for compatible templates.

attributes.name: avatar-text
attributes.description: Avatar initials fallback.

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: Show a separate remove action; icon, color and avatar tags enable it by default, a checkbox tag only when it is set.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the remove action. Defaults to Remove, or Удалить on a Russian page.

attributes.name: color-class
attributes.description: Framework semantic background utility for the color marker.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Optional count shown with the default tag.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable interactive toggle and close actions.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Decorative Framework icon name.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Sit on the text line of another control: no block padding, a flush label, and a remove button the height of the line. The host may publish --sf-tag--line.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: Render the label as a button next to the remove action, for tags that open something (for example a filter chip menu); ignored for checkbox tags.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the tag carries: a checkbox, an icon, a colour, an avatar, or nothing but its label. The compatibility input quantity is still accepted and means default.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Takes the text line of this form size as an inline tag one size down, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height. Overrides size and inline.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the visible root.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Framework size token: sets the label text and the default spacing.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Block padding of a free-standing tag, with the names the buttons use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the tag reports, in the shared status vocabulary. Leave it empty for a tag that reports nothing.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template name.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Visible tag label.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name that answered both questions from one list: a content word reaches kind, a status word reaches status. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Textarea
tags.summary: A native multiline form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and safe vertical resizing.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the field looks: a bordered box, a filled one, or flush -- no box of its own, inside a composite control that draws the box and the focus.

attributes.name: auto-grow
attributes.description: The field follows its text between min-rows and max-rows and scrolls inside past max-rows. CSS field-sizing where supported, a script fallback elsewhere; rows is then ignored.

attributes.name: inherited-text
attributes.description: The words of the marker shown while the inherited value applies. Unset, it follows the page's language («inherited», «наследуется»).

attributes.name: inherited-value
attributes.description: What the field falls back to while it holds no value of its own. Shown as inherited, in the placeholder's ink with an «inherited» marker under the field, never as the value: the form value stays empty. Once the field holds a value of its own, a reset button returns it here.

attributes.name: max-rows
attributes.description: With auto-grow: the most rows before the field scrolls inside. Unset means no cap; a value below min-rows is min-rows.

attributes.name: min-rows
attributes.description: With auto-grow: the fewest rows the field shows. One row is the height of an input of the same size.

attributes.name: reset-label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the button that returns the field to the inherited value. Unset, it follows the page's language («Reset to inherited», «Сбросить к наследуемому»).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Theme generator
tags.summary: A theme from one colour: a person chooses the main colour (or the generator's hue and chroma) and it makes the Framework's eight tonal palettes, the 128 primitives every semantic token reads and the 98 translucent steps core derives from them, with a preview, events carrying the CSS, and an optional live application to the page.

attributes.name: apply
attributes.description: Apply the theme to `target` as inline custom properties, live on every change, undoing the previous application first and on removal. Without it the page is not changed.

attributes.name: chroma
attributes.description: The generator's chroma, 0-150, overriding the colour's reading; set by the fine-tuning fields. Empty reads it from the colour.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.description: The generator's hue, 0-360, overriding the colour's reading; set by the fine-tuning fields. Empty reads it from the colour.

attributes.name: selector
attributes.description: The selector of the rule in the events' css and in toCSS().

attributes.name: swatches
attributes.description: The product's own colours offered beside the picker, as sf-color takes them: '#hex|Name, #hex'.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: A CSS selector for the element the theme is applied to; empty is the document element. A target other than the root carries a theme class (theme-light or theme-dark): the semantic tokens are declared there, so without one only the primitives change on it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The main colour, #rrggbb. Empty means the Framework's own colour (#005bbe) and draws the Framework's own theme.

tags.title: Toast
tags.summary: Transient overlay feedback with semantic roles, optional action, pause-safe lifetime and dismiss behavior.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Stable action value emitted in sf-toast-action.

attributes.name: action-text
attributes.description: Visible label of the one optional action.

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: Render an explicitly named close action.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Localized accessible name of the close action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close message" in English).

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Explicit lifetime in milliseconds. Zero keeps the message until dismissed.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Optional decorative icon name.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Live-region role for dynamically inserted feedback only.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the message reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The words this component used before — default and primary — are still accepted and mean neutral and info.

attributes.name: supporting-text
attributes.description: Concise supporting text at the normal body size.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short result heading.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Tooltip
tags.summary: Tooltip surface that can join the ordinary data-tooltip trigger composition.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the tooltip looks: light on a dark surface or the reverse.

attributes.name: arrow
attributes.description: Logical tail placement.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the visible surface root.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Framework typography and spacing scale.

attributes.name: supporting-text
attributes.description: Optional secondary description.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template name.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Short primary description.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Tree
tags.summary: Accessible hierarchical composite with roving focus, branch expansion and host-owned selection.

attributes.name: accept-files
attributes.description: A node takes files dropped from the computer and says so with sf-tree-files-drop.

attributes.name: accept-records
attributes.description: A node takes the records dragged from a list (application/x-sf-records+json) and says so with sf-tree-records-drop.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Items given as data instead of as sf-tree-item children (set as a property, not an attribute): [{label, href?, target?, rel?, kind?, value?, open?, selected?, active?, disabled?, icon?, openIcon?, closedIcon?, chevronOpenIcon?, chevronClosedIcon?, openLabel?, closeLabel?, children?}]. text or title stand in for label. Setting it replaces the items and re-renders; sf-tree-item children are read once and removed, so a parent that re-renders changed items passes them this way.

tags.title: Tree Item
tags.summary: One accessible node in a Smart Tree hierarchy.

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close item" in English).

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the tree item is: a folder or a file.

attributes.name: open-label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Open item" in English).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.
